items.headline: Meta outlines plans to raise $35 billion through stock sales to fund AI investments
items.summary: Meta’s proposed financing includes a potential additional $60 billion share issuance, while Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom have indicated possible participation totaling $5 billion. The development highlights both demand for AI infrastructure and investor concerns about circular financing.

items.headline: Anthropic files for potentially record-setting IPO
items.summary: Anthropic filed to list on Nasdaq under the proposed ticker ANT. The company reported rapid revenue growth but remained unprofitable, with substantial expected infrastructure requirements and continued losses disclosed in its filing.

items.headline: Nvidia helps lift U.S. stocks as AI shares remain volatile
items.summary: Nvidia rose 2.5% during Monday trading, helping the Nasdaq and S&P 500 recover from prior losses. The broader AI complex remained unsettled because of concerns about the cost of borrowing to build data centers and buy chips.

items.headline: Investors reduce risk exposure amid AI-trade turbulence
items.summary: Axios reported that investors sought safety in stocks and bonds amid market volatility. The equal-weighted S&P 500 outperformed the cap-weighted index as large technology companies weakened, underscoring concentration risk for portfolios heavily exposed to mega-cap AI names.
